roles.name: Manager
roles.description: Has all permissions of Waiter, Cashier, and Chef.

roles.name: Cashier
roles.description: Can process any payment (digital/cash). Cannot modify existing orders without Waiter/Manager confirmation.

roles.name: Waiter
roles.description: Takes and modifies orders, adds products. Can process digital payments only (no cash).

roles.name: Chef
roles.description: Views orders (without prices). Can only update order status: Commanded -> In Progress -> Ready.
